purpose: Candidate language-practice sequence for smoothing new meaningful R/P/grammar loads, independent of any storyline.
counting_rules: first_R counts first required meaning contact, not a learned word
first_P counts first independent production, not repeated exposure
new_grammar_R counts first meaningful form contact, not mastery
revisit is a planned distinct semantic necessity, not spaced repetition or a learning guarantee
word load is not yet measured; names are descriptive labels, not approved lexical entries
P6 adds no new M or G
unit IDs are neither days nor quests nor fixed user lessons
